response.explanation: src/presentation/server.ts is the process entry point and acts as the composition root. Line 1 imports BookingRepository from the persistence layer, and line 19 creates it. That instance is then passed into SessionService, BookingService, IceMonitorService and ReportService (lines 30, 35-36, 45, 52). The same file also imports other persistence types directly: HireStockRepository, PuckPayClient, ClubBookingRepository, SessionRepository, DropTextClient and TemperatureRepository (lines 2-4, 6, 9-10). FF-S03 checks the layering presentation -> business -> persistence. A presentation file that imports a persistence module skips the business layer, so the rule flags the edge server.ts:1 -> bookingRepository.ts. The import is only used for dependency wiring at startup. No request handler reads from or writes to the repository directly, because request handling goes through createApp, which only receives business services (lines 47-55). The coupling is real but narrow: the composition root sits inside the presentation folder, so the presentation layer depends on concrete persistence classes. The usual fix is to move the wiring into a dedicated bootstrap or composition module outside the presentation layer, or to have the business layer expose factories. No project docs, ADRs or comments were provided to show that this placement is intended.
